references.text: In 1 Chronicles 6:75, Hukok (a variant of Helkath) and Rehob are also mentioned as Levitical cities given to the Gershonite clan from the tribe of Asher, confirming the distribution of these cities.
Helkath is mentioned as one of the boundary cities in the territory of the tribe of Asher when the land was divided among the tribes.
Rehob is mentioned several times as a city in the territory of the tribe of Asher, confirming its location within this territory.
This verse introduces the section on the cities given to the Gershonite Levites, where Helkath and Rehob are included as part of the four cities from Asher.
